titleTh: หมวด 4 — สัญญาข้อมูลตามหลักการ (Canonical Data Contracts)
note: Static-only canonical data contracts for Category 4 (การจัดการของเสีย). Each contract models the frozen FY2568 historical baseline only, using only C1-approved mappings and fy2568-publication.json manifest references/hashes. All 5 indicators (4.1.1, 4.1.2, 4.1.3, 4.2.1, 4.2.2) have dedicated evidence — no GAP/MISSING indicator. Annual waste scope is canonical: general waste 4,380.10 kg (target −3% vs 2567 → +1.68% NOT met), total 6,434.70 kg, reuse 31.93% (numeric >50% NOT met — claimed via innovation/compost branch). Monthly-form scope 5,625.7 kg is recorded separately (never conflated). The canonical annual report is the 10-03-69 DOCX (revision 129); the 02-03-69 DOCX is superseded; the 10-03-69 PDF is a reader export. 8 unique scan contents across 10 scan path instances and the garbled 4.1.1(1) measures PDF (cross-reference-only) are honestly disclosed. No invented OCR, signature, approval, score, or FY2569 data. evidenceIds reference the C3 evidence-index entries with matching manifest path/hash/availability.

contracts.note: Cross-indicator FY2568 target clause (general waste reduce 3% vs 2567) from the canonical 10-03-69 annual report. Category-level evidence by design (spans the 4.1.3 data + 4.1.1 measures).
Waste management measures + awareness/participation. The 4.1.1(1) measures PDF is garbled (cross-reference-only); ประกาศเป้าหมาย/บริบท are scans (pending); 4.1.1(3) ปลอดโฟม gap is disclosed.
Waste sorting/collection/disposal implementation (bin layout, labels, holding points, random checks, contractor routing, monitoring, no burning). Two scans pending.

Waste measurement + target analysis + reuse/recycling. Annual scope (6,434.70 total / 4,380.10 general / 31.93% reuse) is canonical; monthly-form scope 5,625.7 recorded separately. Verified year tables 2566/67/68 promoted.
Office wastewater management + effluent quality vs legal standard. Monthly FY2568 effluent statistics verified; skimming record scan pending.
Wastewater treatment care/maintenance (weekly skimming, grease disposal, repair, leak inspection). Skimming scan = byte-identical duplicate of the 4.2.1 record.

forwardRequirements.note: 4.1.1(3) ปลอดโฟม: FY2568 source states no foam-free declaration was made in FY2568; the FY2569 plan exists only as a forward statement in the source note (4.1.1 (3) .txt). Not a verified FY2569 fact.

4.1.1 (4) ประกาศบริบทองค์กรและขอบเขตฯ 2568.pdf — 8-page image scan, content unverifiable without OCR (scope 9,873 m² cross-verified via the report text).
4.1.2 (4) แบบฟอร์มบันทึกการสุ่มตรวจการทิ้งขยะ.pdf — 24-page image scan (monthly random-check records), content unverifiable without OCR.

4.1.3 (1) แบบบันทึกข้อมูลปริมาณขยะ.pdf — 12-page image scan (FY2568 monthly waste log), content unverifiable without OCR (monthly values verified via the promoted year-2568 table and the form XLSX).
บันทึกการตักคราบน้ำมัน และไขมัน.pdf — 4-page image scan present under both 4.2.1(1) and 4.2.2(3) (byte-identical duplicate, G2); content unverifiable without OCR.

4.1.1 (1) มาตรการควบคุมพลังงานและทรัพยากร อาคารเฉลิมพระเกียรติฯ 2568.pdf — Thai text layer present but glyph mapping broken; verified by cross-reference to the section narrative only, glyph layer pending OCR.
No file in the FY2568 Cat4 set contains a signature/approval block. The canonical 10-03-69 report is a historical baseline — no signed/approved submission copy is claimed.
4.1.3(3) numeric threshold '>50% reuse' is NOT met (31.93%). The criterion's alternative branch (innovation/composting) is the honest claim basis — never present 31.93% as meeting >50%.
4.1.3(2)/(4): FY2568 general waste 4,380.10 kg is +72.40 kg (+1.68%) vs 2567 — target reduce 3% NOT met. The 'declining trend' claim is only valid on the 3-year window vs 2566.

The monthly form (XLSX คำนวณ% sheet) totals 5,625.7 kg; the annual report scope totals 6,434.70 kg (adds เศษอาหาร + เศษกิ่งไม้/ใบไม้). Two legitimately different aggregation scopes — both recorded, never conflated.
แบบ ทส.1/ทส.2 monthly wastewater discharge records are external online evidence (building.mju.ac.th bID 18845/18846) — recorded as reference links only, not in the repo.
